lines.zh: 我迈着卫道士的步子，肩上有蝶。
lines.en: I walk with a vindicator's stride, a butterfly on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的斧子垂着，手却放松。
lines.en: My axe hangs low, my grip slack.

lines.zh: 我沿着村子外围走，不进门。
lines.en: I patrol the village edge without entering.
I walk slowly, as if led.

lines.zh: 我肩上的翅膀一开一合。
lines.en: The wings on my shoulder open and close.

lines.zh: 我绕过屋墙，脚步很整齐。
lines.en: I go around the house wall with even steps.

lines.zh: 我从田那头走过来，头微微歪着。
lines.en: I come from the far field, head slightly tilted.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，别的灾厄村民都让开。
lines.en: Where I walk, other illagers give way.
I walk while watching the sky.

lines.zh: 我的步子比平常轻很多。
lines.en: My steps are much lighter than usual.

lines.zh: 我踩过草地，蝶在耳边扇。
lines.en: I cross the grass with the butterfly fanning by my ear.
I pass the doorway and do not go in.
I turn to the butterfly, then back.

lines.zh: 我停在篱笆边，又继续走。
lines.en: I stop at the fence, then walk on.

lines.zh: 我的斧刃上落着一只小东西。
lines.en: A small thing rests on my axe blade.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地走着，像在陪谁。
lines.en: I walk slowly, as if keeping someone company.
I stand, the butterfly beside my face.
My hand opens and closes.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看蝶往上飞了一点。
lines.en: I look up as it lifts a little.
I stand still with empty eyes.
My axe rests by my feet.
The weight on my shoulder is light.

lines.zh: 蝶飞到另一侧，我也转头。
lines.en: It flits to the other side and I turn too.
I have stood here a long while.

lines.zh: 我微微张着嘴，没有说话。
lines.en: My mouth opens slightly, and no words come.
The butterfly settles and lifts; I don't move.

lines.zh: 我身上有一股花粉的味道。
lines.en: I smell of pollen.
I raise a hand toward my shoulder.
Axe blade down; I lower it first.
The thing on my shoulder is looking at you.

lines.zh: 我这只手本来是要挥斧的。
lines.en: This hand was meant to swing an axe.
No need to run; I will not chase.

lines.zh: 斧子举起来了，可这只手不是我的。
lines.en: The axe is raised, but this arm isn't mine.
I tilt my head as if hearing something else.
My eyes are a little out of focus.
Do not come too close; it is shy.
I lower my hand slowly.

lines.zh: 我在想我为什么站在这儿。
lines.en: I am wondering why I am standing here.
I step back and do not retaliate.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我肩上，蝶飞了起来。
lines.en: The blow lands on my shoulder and the butterfly rises.
Blood seeps out; I just watch it.
I hold my shoulder and straighten.
I make a muffled sound.
My axe slips from my hand.
I take half a step back, heavy-footed.
I look at you without anger.

lines.zh: 我身上那股花粉味更浓了。
lines.en: The smell of pollen on me grows stronger.
I lean against the wall slowly.
I smell the flowers in your hand.
I head for that clump of flowers.
Put the net down; it dislikes it.
A strong smell of nectar.
You hold out a hand and I do not back away.
That colour draws it.

lines.zh: 你把灯举起来，它反而靠近。
lines.en: Raise the lamp and it comes nearer.

lines.zh: 你在花丛旁边停下，很好。
lines.en: You stop by the flower bed; good.
Your thing will unsettle it.
I shift half a step toward you.
You bump me and I do not strike back.

lines.zh: 我的斧头垂下，蝶在里头。
lines.en: My axe droops; the butterfly's inside.
The knock makes the butterfly lift.
My hand comes up, then drops.
We brush past and I give a step.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的斧柄，声音闷。
lines.en: You hit my axe haft with a dull knock.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一歪，很快站稳。
lines.en: I go crooked and quickly steady.

lines.zh: 我抬手护着肩上那点东西。
lines.en: I raise a hand to shield the thing on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们分开后，我还在看蝶。
lines.en: After we part, I am still watching the butterfly.
Take it easy; I will move aside.

lines.zh: 我这身体不是我自己在用。
lines.en: This body is not entirely mine to use.
I lift a hand and do not answer.
The butterfly stirs by my ear.
I never had time for such things.

lines.zh: 我举斧的手，已经不是我的。
lines.en: The hand holding this axe isn't mine anymore.
I did not quite catch what you said.
This axe of mine used to feel heavy.
I shake my head, slightly.

lines.zh: 蝶在我身上，我只能听话。
lines.en: The butterfly rides me. I can only obey.
I look toward the flower bed.
I pick it up with my free hand.
I pick it up and hold it out to you.
I bend to pick it up and the butterfly stays put.

lines.zh: 这东西我拿着，不太会放。
lines.en: I hold this and am not sure how to put it down.
I pick up a fallen flower.
I place it on my palm.

lines.zh: 我拾起来又丢掉，动作很慢。
lines.en: I pick it up and drop it, slowly.
I move the axe aside and free a hand.
I show it to the butterfly.
I gather up what fell, one by one.
My neck turns first; the butterfly follows.
The butterfly has flown toward you.
It wants to look at you, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我把注意力放到你身上。
lines.en: I settle my attention on you.
The butterfly goes your way; I follow.
You are the one from before.

lines.zh: 斧柄在我手里，握得很稳。
lines.en: The axe haft sits steady in my hand.
It has stopped above you.

lines.zh: 我没有敌意，只是被带着。
lines.en: No hostility; I am only being led.
My axe still hangs at my belt.
I keep flying toward your side.
You take two steps; so do I.
I follow slowly without stopping.
The butterfly is over your head; I am below.

lines.zh: 你回头，我的眼神还是空的。
lines.en: You look back, and my eyes are still empty.
I go around the stones, toward you.
I neither shout nor raise the axe.
The further you go, the surer my heading.
I lift my face; your scent is in the wind.

lines.zh: 你在花圃边，我就到那儿。
lines.en: You are by the flower bed; I will go there.

lines.zh: 我的手抬起来，轻轻一推。
lines.en: My hand rises and pushes, gently.

lines.zh: 斧柄撞到你，不是我用力。
lines.en: The axe haft hits you, not by my strength.
That was light, like a block.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子往后带。
lines.en: I take your sleeve and draw you back.
I shoulder you aside.
After that, the butterfly flies higher.
I swing once and nearly miss.
My body pushes harder than I mean to.
You step back, and so do I.
That was not a blow I intended.

lines.zh: 我肩上的翅膀先动了一下。
lines.en: The wings on my shoulder move first.

lines.zh: 我站在村口，手里拎着斧子。
lines.en: I stand at the village gate with my axe.

lines.zh: 我从掠夺者队伍那边走过来。
lines.en: I come over from the raider band's side.
You see the butterfly before you see me.

lines.zh: 我出现在田边，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I appear at the field edge with light steps.
I raise my head slowly and look at you.
There is a dusting of pollen on me.

lines.zh: 我背着斧子，从树林里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the trees with the axe on my back.
This patch is strangely quiet.

lines.zh: 我落地时，蝶也落在我肩上。
lines.en: As I land, the butterfly settles on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 火星落在肩上，我赶紧拍掉。
lines.en: Sparks land on my shoulder and I brush them off.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，斧子飞了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my axe flies off.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我挣了两下。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I thrash twice.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀倒，蝶不见了。
lines.en: The blast knocks me down, and the butterfly is gone.

lines.zh: 箭射中我的腿，我单膝跪地。
lines.en: An arrow takes my leg and I drop to one knee.

lines.zh: 法术打来，我的动作更僵了。
lines.en: Magic hits and my movements stiffen further.

lines.zh: 我饿得站不稳，扶着斧柄。
lines.en: Hunger makes me unsteady; I lean on the axe.
Lightning strikes and my whole body jerks.
The void pulls me and I grip the fence.
